reviewer: Claude Opus 5, WP3 route-authz lane (evidence run executed by the integration owner, automated session)
reviewedChange: Resolves the task's own Project instead of the ambient cookie. Previously getTaskDetail(id, cookieWorkspace) filtered on workspace_id AND id, which answered you may not read this and there is nothing here with the same empty result, and got the first one wrong: a task in another Project the caller fully belongs to rendered Task not found. Reproduced against a schema-baseline database before changing anything. Now the task's stored Project is read, membership of THAT Project is proved as its own step, and only then does the tenant-scoped read run, scoped by the proven Project. Missing, forbidden and deleted collapse into one not-found variant so the route cannot grow a distinguishable state. RENDERED OUTPUT CHANGED MATERIALLY: an active task no longer renders the full-page focus view on this route, it redirects to /app/tasks?task=...&workspaceId=... per ADR 0001 section 8; the archived read-only state and the not-found state are unchanged. The bound fixture tasks.surface.task-detail-panel is the detail panel, not this route, and is unaffected. This surface has screenshotCoverage none and no approvedBaselineReference, so there is no baseline that could have caught the redirect; that coverage gap is the finding.
